about_short_description.short_description: Unifonic is a customer engagement platform that unifies communication channels to enable organizations to delight customers.

product.name: Unifonic AI-Native Customer Experience Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform for managing AI-assisted customer engagement, communications, workflows, campaigns, and customer journeys across multiple channels.

product.name: AI-Powered Customer Lifecycle Solutions
product.description: AI-enabled solutions for customer acquisition, support, onboarding, identity verification, retention, and lifecycle engagement across messaging, voice, web, and social channels.

product.name: Unifonic Communications Channels
product.description: Omnichannel messaging and communications services supporting SMS, voice, WhatsApp, web chat, in-app chat, email, push notifications, and social messaging.

product.name: Chatbot Builder
product.description: A tool for creating AI-powered chatbots that automate customer conversations, collect information, answer questions, and transfer complex interactions to human agents.

product.name: Flow Studio
product.description: A visual workflow automation tool for designing customer journeys and connecting communication flows with CRM, ERP, e-commerce, and other business systems.

product.name: Multichannel Campaigns
product.description: A campaign management service for creating, scheduling, and monitoring customer communications across supported messaging and digital channels.
